verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a dedicated re-authorise account consent endpoint. It prompts the account holder for continued access when a previously AUTHORIZED consent can no longer retrieve data, so the repair happens on the existing consent rather than as a fresh link. The other half of the story, expired or revoked consents surfacing as documented statuses, is only implied by the reference to the AUTHORIZED state, and no consent-expiry or revocation webhooks are shown. Missing for 10: documented consent status values for expired and revoked links, consent-expiry or revocation notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the re-auth flow.
